text:
Ask Google's AI Mode for a dog groomer in Fremantle.

BrightLocal tested AI Mode on local searches. Its main source for business details: the Google Business Profile.

So the profile that puts you on the map also feeds Google's AI answers.

Check your hours, services and phone number there.

Most tradies stop marketing when they get busy.

Three months later the phone goes quiet. They start again from zero.

The majority is ALWAYS wrong.

Keep your Google profile and ads running through the busy months. That work builds on itself.

Someone tells you SEO takes 90 days. Someone else says 12 months.

Ask them both: "Have you looked at my suburb yet?"

If not, they're guessing. How long it takes depends on your suburb and who's already on the map there.
